title: Proof of concept study on early forecasting of antimicrobial resistance in hospitalized patients using machine learning and simple bacterial ecology data.
summary: The primary proof-of-concept uses machine learning on 44,026 hospital microbiology records to estimate antimicrobial susceptibility before antibiogram availability, with stage-specific held-out performance. Evidence is retrospective at one hospital and does not show prospective treatment changes or outcomes.
